visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a vertical frame with a soft-focus background of a field during sunset, with tall grass swaying slightly in the golden hour light. A central white parchment-style card is the focal point, adorned with a watercolor illustration of red roses on the right side. Overlaid text on the card cycles rapidly through three distinct inspirational quotes written in Traditional Chinese. The lighting is warm and natural-looking, with a subtle shimmering stardust filter overlaid on the entire frame, creating a magical atmosphere. No human characters, animals, or complex objects are present other than the card and background greenery.
